title: Asset / Sensor Trends
description: sgp7_dev trends: one searchable multi-select of Asset | Sensor. One graph per selected sensor. Anomaly predictions show actual + predicted; others use telemetry_sensors_1min_agg. Default last 24 hours (SGT).

list.name: sensors
list.label: Asset | Sensor
list.description: Type to search. Multi-select sensors across any assets. Label format: AssetName | SensorName
list.query: SELECT sm.sensor_id AS __value, COALESCE(NULLIF(am.asset_name, ''), am.asset_id) || ' | ' || COALESCE(NULLIF(sm.sensor_name, ''), sm.sensor_id) AS __text FROM sgp7_dev.sensor_master sm INNER JOIN sgp7_dev.asset_master am ON am.asset_id = sm.asset_id ORDER BY 2
list.definition: SELECT sm.sensor_id AS __value, COALESCE(NULLIF(am.asset_name, ''), am.asset_id) || ' | ' || COALESCE(NULLIF(sm.sensor_name, ''), sm.sensor_id) AS __text FROM sgp7_dev.sensor_master sm INNER JOIN sgp7_dev.asset_master am ON am.asset_id = sm.asset_id ORDER BY 2

targets.rawSql:
WITH has_pred AS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM sgp7_dev.anomaly_predictions p
  WHERE p.sensor_id = '${sensors}'
    AND $__timeFilter(p.eventdatetime)
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT p.eventdatetime AS "time",
       'actual' AS metric,
       p.actual_value::double precision AS value
FROM sgp7_dev.anomaly_predictions p
WHERE p.sensor_id = '${sensors}'
  AND $__timeFilter(p.eventdatetime)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM has_pred)
UNION ALL
SELECT p.eventdatetime AS "time",
       'predicted' AS metric,
       p.predicted_value::double precision AS value
FROM sgp7_dev.anomaly_predictions p
WHERE p.sensor_id = '${sensors}'
  AND $__timeFilter(p.eventdatetime)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM has_pred)
UNION ALL
SELECT t.eventdatetime AS "time",
       'telemetry' AS metric,
       t.value::double precision AS value
FROM sgp7_dev.telemetry_sensors_1min_agg t
WHERE t.sensorid = '${sensors}'
  AND $__timeFilter(t.eventdatetime)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM has_pred)
ORDER BY 1
